title: Wildcard field - add normalisation of ngram tokens to reduce disk space.

timeline.body:
All punctuation becomes `/` char and for `A-Z0-9` chars turn even codepoints to prior odd e.g. aab becomes aaa.

Closes #62817
Can we generalize the block checks above with `Character.isLetterOrDigit() == false` ?
We could add the lowercase filter here instead of lowercasing outside of the analyzer ? I also wonder if putting a `ASCIIFoldingFilter` makes sense but that's maybe a different scope.
This should depend on the index created version ?
You don't need to resolve this at query-time. The correct analyzer can be picked once from the index created version when the field type is created.
I left some comments but I like this change a lot! It reduces the size significantly and almost transparently for users which is great news!

Good to go on this @jimczi ?
I just ran this PR on a 7.9-built index and the BWC stuff looks to be working OK (I added test logic for this scenario but wanted to double-check all was working outside of test conditions).
nit: can we rename into `PunctuationFoldingFilter` or something similar ?
Left a minor comment, LGTM otherwise

timeline.message:
Add normalisation of ngram tokens to reduce disk space.
All punctuation becomes / char and for A-Z0-9 chars turn even codepoints to prior odd e.g. aab becomes aaa

Closes #62817
